invariants_acknowledged: Owner ruling Q1=A: case types are applied only at case creation (priority, deadline, required fields, checklist seeded as CaseTasks); caseTypeId is never changed by cases.update.
Owner ruling Q2=Yes: with no type, PG-190 CaseSettings.defaultPriority and tenant CaseRequiredField rows apply; precedence is explicit input > type > module default > MEDIUM.
Required fields follow the same fallback: a type with a non-empty requiredFields set uses it, otherwise tenant rows (or DEFAULT_CASE_REQUIRED_FIELDS); checked on effective, trimmed values.
Every caseTypes query and mutation passes tenantId explicitly; cases(tenantId, caseTypeId) -> case_types(tenantId, id) is a composite FK so a cross-tenant link fails at the DB.
All caseTypes procedures use moduleTenantProcedure(LEGAL); mutations require CASE_TYPE_ADMIN_ROLES (ADMIN, MANAGER; OWNER/SUPER_ADMIN forward-compat).
Multi-row writes run in $transaction; never skipDuplicates; P2002 maps to CONFLICT with constraint-specific static messages; Prisma messages are never returned.
The page is the existing stub at apps/web/src/app/cases/(list)/case-types/page.tsx (served at /cases/case-types); no second route is created; the sidebar entry already exists.
The migration is additive Class A (new tables + nullable column); it is applied only to the local test DB here and must be applied to production manually before the code ships (L13).
colorToken is one of the 8 CASE_TAG_COLOR_TOKENS, enforced by Zod and a DB CHECK; AI toggles: none added.
